findings.location: Aya ya utangulizi kuhusu asili ya unyenyekevu
findings.source_quote: “as the virtue of humility is as old as God himself.”
findings.suggested_fix: “kwa kuwa sifa ya unyenyekevu ni ya zamani kama Mungu mwenyewe.”
findings.translation_quote: “kwa kuwa sifa ya unyenyekevu ni ya zamani kama Mungu mwenyewe.”

findings.location: Aya kuhusu deni la dhambi na neema
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “talanta elfu kumi” kuwa “pauni elfu kumi” ili kuhifadhi kipimo cha deni kilichochapishwa.

findings.location: Aya ya ushauri kuhusu kutubu na kukubali mapenzi ya Mungu
findings.source_quote: “Be admonished that the indignation of God be not your eternal lot.”
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha “Onwa” kuwa “Pokea maonyo, ili ghadhabu ya Mungu isiwe fungu lako la milele.”
findings.translation_quote: “Onwa ili ghadhabu ya Mungu isiwe fungu lako la milele.”

findings.location: Aya kuhusu mwanamke mwenye dhambi na Yesu
findings.source_quote: “washing them with tears and wiping them with the hairs of her head”
findings.suggested_fix: Taja miguu waziwazi: “akiiosha miguu ya Yesu kwa machozi na kuifuta kwa nywele za kichwa chake.”
findings.translation_quote: “akimwosha kwa machozi na kuyafuta kwa nywele za kichwa chake”

findings.suggested_fix: Ondoa urudufu: “Katika matendo na shughuli zake”.

findings.location: Aya ya pili ya mwisho, inayohusu kuepuka mapambo ya bure
findings.source_quote: “approve of the needless and vain ornamenting and decorating of our houses and our families”
findings.suggested_fix: Fafanua kuwa kinachopambwa ni nyumba na familia: “tunaunga mkono mapambo ya bure na yasiyo ya lazima ya nyumba zetu na ya familia zetu”.
findings.translation_quote: “tunaunga mkono urembo na mapambo yasiyo ya lazima na ya bure ya nyumba zetu na familia zetu”
